app_fee.value: Application fee is $60 for domestic applicants and $100 for international applicants.
app_fee.quote: Submit the online application to the Graduate College and pay the $60 application fee by credit card ($100 for international applicants).

fee_waiver.value: Applicants for whom payment of the application fee presents a significant financial hardship may request an application fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants for whom payment of the application fee presents a significant financial hardship may request an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: GRE requirements vary by academic program and are not stated centrally.
gre_general.quote: Application deadlines and required supplemental materials vary by academic program so it’s important that you review the program-specific instructions including supplemental materials required by your academic program.

ielts_min.value: Overall score of 7 with no subscore less than 6.
